drums.description: Hard rock instrumental featuring a prominent, syncopated stomp-clap percussion pattern, The arrangement centers on a distorted electric guitar playing a blues-influenced, mid-tempo riff in E minor at 90 BPM, A gritty, overdriven bass guitar doubles the main riff, locking tightly with the kick drum, The percussion consists of a heavy, resonant kick drum on beats one and three, paired with layered handclaps and a crisp snare on beats two and four, Occasional tambourine accents provide high-frequency shimmer, The guitar utilizes palm-muting during the verses and opens up into sustained power chords during the transition phases, A secondary lead guitar enters with slide-driven melodic fills and wah-pedal filtered licks, The production is dry with minimal reverb, emphasizing a raw, garage-rock aesthetic Publish
